Hi Kate —

Appreciate the checklist — that helps. Quick answers up front:

- Model variant: we will serve the 13B quantized v2 profile (Q4). We'll include the runtime profile and perf numbers in the MAP appendix so legal can verify the footprint.
- Freeze window: we can commit to a telemetry freeze for two weeks pre- and post-launch for the pilot.

For the signer order, Camila (legal) and Kimberly (ops/CS handoff) are looped in — Camila, can you confirm if Redwood legal needs the SOC2 binder before Procurement signs or if a redline with evidence references is acceptable?

If Procurement wants early DocuSign routing, we can provision the signer order as: Atlas Legal -> Atlas Procurement -> Redwood Legal -> Redwood Ops. If that looks long, we can collapse Atlas approvals into a single combined signer role.

I'll draft a short mutual action plan appendix with explicit sign windows and send it shortly.

Thanks,

Hi all —

We reviewed the procurement intake. Short version from Legal: we do not require the SOC2 binder to be fully issued before Atlas signs; we need a link to the evidence package and an explicit retention & access clause (sample language below).

Proposed minimal language for DocuSign (legal to legal):
"Redwood will provide SOC2 Type II evidence and audit contact information to Atlas within five (5) business days of countersignature. Data retention and access terms are as set in Appendix B."

Sign windows: to keep the yes/no decision tight, suggest the following cadence:
- DocuSign sent: Friday 5/8 at 09:00 PT
- Atlas signers: 72 hours (target by Mon 5/11 EOD)
- Redwood signers: 48 hours (target by Wed 5/13 EOD)

If Atlas hits their target and we countersign by 5/13, the earliest realistic prep week is Jun 7 and earliest pilot start is Jun 14. If Atlas needs longer, slide two weeks.

Also attaching a short Esign_Signer_Order.xlsx (provisioning order + fallback) — Procurement, please confirm the primary signer email for Atlas Procurement.

Camila
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Esign_Signer_Order.xlsx (xlsx)

Camila —

Thanks for the language. Procurement confirms primary signer is michael.carr@atlasretail.com and secondary is contracts@atlasretail.com. 72 hours for Atlas looks aggressive but acceptable — we'll try to get Legal and Procurement in the same day.

1) Can Redwood include a short runbook (1 page) for day-0 rollback conditions and who to call? Procurement wants a simple gating checklist signed by both sides pre-launch.
2) Is Redwood able to guarantee the quantized profile will be used in production for the first 30 days (to match the perf numbers provided)?

If both are yes, Procurement will greenlight DocuSign on Friday.
